EasyUse Anima 1.1.2 fixes long file-backed wildcard prompts.

Changes:
1. Long wildcard lines containing many comma-separated tags and natural-language text now expand instead of falling back to the wildcard filename.
2. Prompt Corrector now receives the expanded content rather than normalizing an unresolved token such as __name__ into a filename-like phrase.
3. Recursive wildcard expansions retain growth protection, and all expanded output remains bounded by absolute size, depth, replacement, and cycle limits.
4. Existing wildcard syntax, sequential/random selection, seeds, workflows, and public node contracts remain compatible.

Action required:
After updating, restart ComfyUI. Existing wildcard files do not need to be rewritten.
